utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Kira! I heard you're organizing that repair drive for the community center. How's it going so far?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, I think you've got the wrong person—I haven't organized anything. Are you sure it's me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, my mistake! I could've sworn I heard your name mentioned. Well, whoever's doing it, I hope they get the roof fixed before the next big rain.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Noah, I heard there's a repair drive happening this weekend. Are you planning to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, a repair drive? Is that this weekend? I thought it was next month. What are they fixing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's definitely this weekend! I heard they're fixing small appliances and electronics, like toasters and laptops.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hi Ira, is the repair drive still happening today?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hi Leo! Far as I know, it's still on—I saw the flyer on the bulletin board this morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, I've got a broken shelf to bring by. What time does it start again?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Cleo, I heard about the repair drive. Are you helping out with that?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, I've been sorting through the supplies we have.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's good. I was thinking of checking in to see if anyone needed a hand with the heavy lifting.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Jules, have you heard when the repair drive is starting? I need to schedule it around the kids' school pickups.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think it's supposed to kick off Saturday morning around 9, but let me double-check with the organizers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That'd be great, thanks. Just as long as it's not during the afternoon chaos with school runs, I should be able to help out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, Oren, what's the plan for the repair drive? I like to know the schedule ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think it's... uh, let me check my calendar... I'm not sure actually. Did we finalize a date?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I’d appreciate if we could nail down a date soon. I like to mark these things on my calendar well in advance.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia! I'm spreading the word about the neighborhood repair drive—are you in?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that sounds nice, but how are we going to organize the drop-off times? I don't want tools sitting out in the rain.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great point! I was thinking we could use the community center’s covered porch—what do you think?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: A repair drive? I must've missed that memo. What kind of repairs are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, it's for everyone in the neighborhood! We're fixing up old appliances, mending clothes, and patching up furniture a couple weekends from now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds wonderful! I've got a rickety old chair that could use some love—think I could bring that?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, the repair drive? Have you had a chance to look at the manual for it yet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Not yet, I've been meaning to pick it up from the community center. Have you found it helpful?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I glanced through it yesterday — it’s pretty thorough, but I’d need to double-check a few steps before trying anything on my own.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I... I think I might have some spare tools in my shed if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, that's real kind of you. I've got a wrench or two I could pitch in with as well.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Maybe we can sort through what we've got together later.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mina, I heard you're organizing that repair drive. I've got a full set of wrenches and some spare screws if you need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I'll take 'em. When can you drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can swing by this evening around 6, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Did you check if the repair drive is still in the garage where we left it last?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hmm, I haven't looked. I've been swamped. You might want to check yourself.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Alright, I'll go take a look now—it's better to be sure than sorry.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Rey, heard we're doing a repair drive. I've got a whole shed full of tools if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I might take you up on that. Do you have a wrench set I could borrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure do, got a full metric and standard set. Swing by whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Kira, are you sure the repair drive has enough gas to get to everyone who needs help? I don't want anyone getting stranded.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Didn't you fill it up yourself just yesterday? I saw you at the station.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I did, but I'm just worried—what if we have to make extra trips or detours? That tank might not stretch as far as we think.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara! I heard you're organizing that repair drive—count me in to help rally some folks from my side of the street.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Jules, that's wonderful! I was hoping you'd be on board—your block always turns out strong for these things.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, my block loves a good cause! I'll start spreading the word tonight at the potluck.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Dane, what supplies are we looking to gather for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Honestly, I just got here—anyone got a list of what we're short on?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We're low on lumber and nails, and we could use some extra paint brushes. Got any leads?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Faye, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? I think they're fixing up the old community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh yes, I heard about that! I'm hoping to swing by on Saturday after I drop the kids off at their soccer practice.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I'll probably be there too. I heard they could use some extra hands for painting.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Rosa, you mentioned something about the repair drive? Sorry, I was kind of in a rush earlier.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries at all! I was just thinking we could pool our tools and skills to help fix up folks' homes this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, that sounds good. What time Saturday did you have in mind?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, I heard you're working on a repair drive. Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I could use some help lifting this old lawnmower into the truck.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, let me grab the other side. On three.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, have you heard about the repair drive happening this Saturday? I'm spreading the word—everyone's pitching in to fix up the community center!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn't heard about that! What all needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Well, the roof's got a leak, the gutters are clogged, and the old wooden steps are starting to rot. We could really use a hand!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: So, Eli, where exactly is this repair drive happening? I like to keep track of these things.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It's at the community center parking lot, right off Maple Street. Starts at nine sharp on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Maple Street community center, got it. I'll make sure my schedule's clear for that.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, have you heard anything about the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Repair drive? I haven't heard anything yet. What's it about?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's a community event where people bring broken items to fix instead of throwing them away. Are you interested in volunteering?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Oren, I heard you're organizing that repair drive—need any help picking up supplies while I'm out?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Ira! Yes, that would be wonderful. I keep misplacing my list, but I think we need screws and maybe some glue.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can grab screws and glue from the hardware store. Any particular size or type you need?
